source_note: frozen git archive of HEAD a679c0f3ebf52729761262c8ae080cb9d5030ccd, extracted read-only into a scratch dir; data_cache symlinked to the repo checkout

prereg.quantity: reach.compute_reach(...)['headline_under_reached_fraction'], i.e. F(0.1): the fraction of VIABLE tumour cells whose steady-state concentration is below 0.1 x the perivascular reference E_ref
prereg.statement: PRE-REGISTERED, BEFORE MEASUREMENT. The shipped steady-state reach verdict is declared RESOLUTION-DEPENDENT -- and the shipped default dx = 12 um declared NOT on the converged side -- if EITHER: (1) |F(0.1; dx_k+1) - F(0.1; dx_k)| > 0.01 for any single refinement step at dx <= 12 um (12->10, 10->8, 8->7), for either compound; or (2) the categorical verdict -- the dominant limiter from sim.mechanism.survival_breakdown, or the delivery-vs-dose call among exposure-limited survivors -- differs between any two rungs of the ladder, for either compound. SECONDARY, reported either way and NOT a substitute for the above: the full-ladder span max|F(0.1)| - min|F(0.1)| over 30..7 um, called LARGE above 0.05. If (1) or (2) fires the headline of results/dx_sensitivity_steady.md says FAILED and no other metric is substituted for F(0.1).

shipped_reference.source: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, stock GET /api/defaults spec run end-to-end in the container

A_mode_is_steady.catches: a dropped drug= argument, which would silently make every rung a finite-window map of a different field

B_rungs_distinct.catches: a sweep that reused one reconstruction, which would report perfect convergence with every rung green

C_shipped_reproduced.catches: a harness that is not the shipped pipeline, whose convergence statement would be about something else

E_one_source_tree.catches: a concurrent edit to the physics or compile chain landing mid-sweep -- the defect that destroyed the first attempt at this sweep and produced a 2.8x kill_fraction jump that would have read as a mesh effect

F_repeat_bit_identical.catches: any drift -- source, cache or otherwise -- between the first rung and the last. A rung re-run AFTER the whole ladder must return bit-identical numbers to the one run BEFORE it.
